intro: Grunth is an energetic young orc orphan living under the care of the Orgrimmar orphanage in the Drag. During Children's Week, he eagerly accompanies Horde champions on grand journeys across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms to learn what it means to be a hero.

sections.t: A Curious Child of the Horde
p: Residing in the Drag of Orgrimmar under the watchful gaze of Orphan Matron Battlewail, Grunth represents the next generation of the newly established Horde. Like many young greenskins raised in Durotar's harsh red wastes, he looks upon armored adventurers with wide-eyed awe and an inexhaustible stream of questions—wondering whether armored warriors are truly terrifying, why lightning on water doesn't kill every fish, and whether he will ever see someone fight an actual dragon.

When festival season arrives, adventurers blow an Orcish Orphan Whistle to summon Grunth and take him on an expansive tour across the world. His bucket list spans the breadth of the Horde's domain: seeking an audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Mulgore, venturing into the ruined throne room of Lordaeron, and visiting the rugged frontiers where his people fight for their future.
